evals.expected_output: An agent_rules_review.md artifact containing the 5-vector audit findings, before/after Attention Budget metrics, and a full 3-tier refactored proposal (Always Do, Ask First, Never Do), halting for user confirmation before writing changes.

evals.prompt: Optimize this system prompt ruleset to eliminate rule drift and organize it into Tier 1 Always Do, Tier 2 Ask First, and Tier 3 Never Do.
evals.expected_output: A structured 3-tier refactor that eliminates self-duplication, strips out common-sense aphorisms, scopes conflicting directives, and presents the proposal via an artifact with an inline summary.
